dish: Chicken tikka masala, chicken makhani (butter chicken) and vegetable samosas — North Indian, family-style platters
w: Family-owned North Indian kitchen in the Merriman Valley since 1997. Signal Akron readers' Best Ethnic/International Food in both 2025 and 2026, and a 330 Flavor Awards Best Indian winner; Akron Life features it in its Merriman Valley guide.

dish: The garlicky white pizza (about half the business since 1993), plus off-the-wall topping pies
w: Family-run Firestone Park pizzeria since 1993. Won the Akron Beacon Journal's 2025 best-pizza-in-Akron reader bracket (nearly 4,000 votes) and Signal Akron's 2026 Best Pizza after two years as runner-up. Second shop at 1581 Canton Rd, Ellet.

dish: The Famous Ido Burger (Angus chuck–brisket blend, grilled mushrooms & onions, American cheese); pimento burger with fried green tomatoes
w: Firestone Park tavern that has been an Akron tradition since World War II. Signal Akron readers' Best Burger 2026, and an Akron Life Burger Week pick.

dish: "The Opener" (scrambled eggs, sausage links, potato browns, toast); Bloody Marys four ways; weekend blueberry-cornmeal pancakes
w: Wallhaven breakfast-and-brunch spot, one of the first in town to pour cocktails with breakfast. Signal Akron readers' Best Breakfast 2025; profiled by Akron Life.

dish: Wine flights and by-the-glass pours from a 1,200-bottle retail wall, with a small-plates kitchen
w: Part wine shop, part wine bar and restaurant in Pilgrim Square on the Akron–Fairlawn line. Signal Akron readers' Best Date Night 2025; Akron Life listing.

dish: Wine tastings and flights from a ~950-label list (4,500-bottle cellar), with small bites
w: Downtown Canton wine bar — the only Stark County establishment with a Wine Spectator award: its 10th recognition and 5th Best of Award of Excellence (2026), one of 16 in Ohio (Canton Repository).

dish: Local grass-fed burgers (a new specialty burger every month) with homemade fries
w: Downtown Canton bar since 1959, a founding member of the Historic Music Block with free live bands. Repeat Canton Repository readers' Best Burger / Best Bar / Best Fries winner; in the Repository's downtown dining guide and Visit Canton's Stark County burger list.

dish: House-roasted espresso drinks and house-blended teas
w: Downtown Canton coffeehouse since 2003 that roasts on site and buys direct from farms and tea growers; open-mic Tuesdays. In both of the Canton Repository's downtown-dining and Stark County coffee guides, and Visit Canton's coffee roundup.

address: 4305 Portage St NW, North Canton, OH 44720
dish: Italian appetizers, house Italian sausage, risotto and pasta alongside steaks
w: Jackson Township Italian grille voted Best Restaurant in Stark County in Akron Life's 2026 330 Flavor Awards (#1 in the 330 in 2022). Reopened after an 18-month closure caused by a car crash into the kitchen (Canton Repository).

address: 129 N Canal St (upstairs, The Barrel Room on Canal), Canal Fulton, OH 44614
dish: 1930s-style Rosé Martini and premium classic cocktails
w: Speakeasy lounge opened in September 2022 above The Barrel Room on Canal by owner Keri Sullivan. Named one of USA TODAY's 2026 Bars of the Year — one of four Ohio picks (Canton Repository).

dish: Soft-serve "kustard" and 30+ rotating homemade ice-cream flavors; boozy adult shakes
w: Portage Lakes ice-cream stand since 1969, now with shops in Green, North Canton, Bath and Cuyahoga Falls. Akron Life readers' Best Ice Cream (2023, 2025); on Ohio Magazine's roadside ice-cream stands list; Cleveland Magazine on its boozy shakes.
